problems: Blind guess ('fish or leaf', 'bird', 'hook or blade') does not identify a kite. The top-left diamond is too thin and ragged to read as a kite, and the long string is not read as part of the same figure.

The kite is cramped in the top-left, with the apex (108036, ~145,110), top-right (107095, ~200,118), left bridle (107556, ~177,158), right corner (106985, ~210,168), lower-left (107188, ~198,210) and bottom (106723, ~222,220) packed within about 80px. It reads as a sliver, not a diamond with a crossbar.
A second blue path runs alongside the gold outline on the kite and the string, so the figure looks doubled. The blue line is not needed and makes the silhouette ambiguous.

Labels overlap badly: 'far end of the tail ribbon' collides with 'top apex' and 'top-right corner'; 'left bridle knot' collides with 'right corner'; 'lower-left corner' collides with 'bottom point'; 'long string, first bend' collides with 'running down an'. Several labels are cut off.

Star placement is mostly right: the tail far end 109139 (~85,118) trails left, the bridle knot is the bright star at ~177,158, and the string runs down-right from 106039 to 104234 and then straight down to 104174 at the bottom. The figure is upright, with the tail left and the string trailing down-right. The gold lines are a wireframe through the stars, not a filled silhouette.

The string stars 105881 and 106039 sit very close together, so the 'first bend' reads as a kink rather than a bend. Unlabelled extra stars (around 320,244; 370,230; 447,338; 420,367; 307,465; 375,470) add clutter.
output.advice:
Redraw the kite as one clean diamond with a crossbar, then the tail and string as separate, labelled strokes.
1) Kite outline as a closed loop: 108036 (apex, ~145,110) → 107095 (top-right, ~200,118) → 106985 (right corner, ~210,168) → 106723 (bottom, ~222,220) → 107188 (lower-left, ~198,210) → 107556 (left bridle, ~177,158) → back to 108036. Draw the crossbar as a single line 107556 → 106985. Remove the blue duplicate path.
2) Tail: a single stroke from 107556 (or 108036) out to 109139 (~85,118), trailing left. Make it visibly separate from the kite outline.
3) String: one continuous line 106723 (bottom point of kite, ~222,220) → 106039 (~262,266) → 105881 (~271,277) → 104234 (~355,327) → 104174 (~355,470). Drop the separate blue arc. Keep the 105881/106039 bend, but it needs more separation to read as a bend.
4) Labels: stagger them with leader lines. Put 'top apex' above-left of 108036, 'far end of tail' left of 109139, 'top-right corner' above 107095, 'right corner' right of 106985, 'left bridle knot' left of 107556, 'bottom point' below 106723, 'lower-left corner' left of 107188. Keep the string labels to the right of their stars, and do not stack them.
5) Remove the unlabelled extra stars (around 320,244; 370,230; 447,338; 420,367; 307,465; 375,470) or render them as faint background dots so they do not read as part of the figure.
Keep the figure upright (tail left, string down-right) and do not mirror it."
